title: Playing Speck's dances: Jitney dances, Shark Bay and the twelve-by-twelve room
summary: He plays jitney dances and then Speck's early dances in a tiny grocery in Marrero with a three-piece band, alternating white and colored nights.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah, all over the river, you see. Then, we played at Fireman's Hall. When the first start giving dance was Jitney dance, you see. Jitney dance, I played that for eight or nine years there, you see. So, then by the Zalmo, I played there for Specs. That was Specs taught. Really?
I didn't know that. Yeah, we first, Specs taught giving dance, by the Zalmo, then, then he went to, uh, Shark Bay, they call it. That's a French. That's French.

Yeah, that down, that down the bar, you know. Yeah, Shark Bay, we played there in that place for him. And after that, after he left from there, he decided to run dance in Marrero, see, Walkerstown. See, that was a, that was a building, that was a building, it was nothing but a house, you know, a little grocery store, see. So, we started playing in there. For white?
Me, Joe, me, Joe, and the boy, Buckeye, with the Buckeye. That's three pieces. What did he play?

Mm-hmm. So, we played, we played, uh, Joe James, man. Yeah, yeah, Joe James, too. On piano. Yeah, on piano. Yeah, on piano. But it's three, she was nothing but a house, like, you know, so, a room wouldn't, maybe we'll put this size, you know what I mean.
